why_it_is_not_finished: The leaf is a pale exposure and its ink is patchy. read_census_continuation's ink mask - 45 grey levels below a 25-px local background, the setting every other sheet in this deposit was read at - resolves the TOTAL column into 28 lines. Lowered to 24 it finds a further figure near y1574, in a 158-px gap between the 28-line index's lines 12 and 13 where the leaf's median line step is 78. And the manufactures column carries two strokes, near y1139 and y2428, that sit in TOTAL-column gaps of 85 and 128 px - each wide enough for a line whose TOTAL figure this threshold does not see. So the committed 28 is an artefact of the threshold, the count is probably 30 or 31, and a per-line reading written on top of a wrong line index would be worse than no reading at all. Recorded rather than guessed.

column_geometry.how: Vertical printed rules located as a column-darkness profile over the ENUMERATOR'S FOOTER band, y2933-3000, against a 61-px moving-average background. The footer band is used and not the header band, and that is the finding worth carrying: the header band on this leaf carries the printed column captions, whose lettering pulls the profile's peaks about 35 px off true. Read off the header, this sheet's industry rules come out at 1381/1449/1513/1577/1658/1739/1819 - a whole column's width of error on a 65-px column, which put every entry in the wrong column and made the footings land on rules. The footer band is printed rules and the enumerator's own figures only.
column_geometry.corroboration: The seven industry widths that fall out of these rules are 65, 65, 65, 81, 81, 82, 62. 33SQ-GYYJ-9CZ, read in full by T-0747 off the same printed form, measures 72, 64, 64, 81, 79, 82, 64. The two leaves agree column for column, which is what says these rules are the form's and not this profile's.

footer_as_read.how: the enumerator's own footing row read at 3.2x, cell by cell, against the rules above.
footer_as_read.the_two_stroke_figure: This leaf writes two figures as two strokes and they have to be told apart. The TOTAL footing is 1, 5, and a two-stroke figure carrying a HORIZONTAL BAR across it - a 4, which gives 154 and agrees with the population key pairing_key_26_50.json read off the same cell. The manufactures footing is two clean parallel strokes with NO bar - an 11, and the column carries eleven or twelve single-stroke entries above it, which is what an 11 there means. The bar is the discriminator on this leaf and it is stated here because the same two-stroke problem cost 33S7-9YYJ-6H a whole re-reading (T-0645).
